title: Starter Studio: codeflow screenshot suite for first-run model select and request composer
creator: Anita Gomez
description: Bundle of visual assets for the new 'Starter Studio' quickstart flow aimed at first-time Hosted API users. This ticket covers screen captures and annotated exports for: 1) model selection (compact vs expanded), 2) interactive request composer with example prompts and structured-output toggles, and 3) three language/SDK code-snippet variants (Python, Node, cURL). Deliverables will include production-ready PNGs and SVGs sized for docs hero (1200x600), inline tutorial tiles (760x400), and small thumbnails (320x180). Assets must follow naming convention and include alt text metadata for the docs ingestion pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Model selector: provide 3 variants (compact card list, grid with performance badges, and expanded details panel) exported at hero and tile sizes
Request composer: show prefilled prompt examples for generative, chat, and structured output; include toggles for streaming and function/tool calling; annotate key UI affordances
Code snippets: provide matching example snippets for Python, Node, and cURL that use the recommended SDK patterns and the same example prompt; include copy-to-clipboard state in screenshots
All images exported with filenames and alt text in the attachments manifest and uploaded to the Drive folder linked in 'links'
Accessibility review passed for contrast and keyboard focus states (QA note recorded in comments)
Design review approval by Priya Kapoor (PM) and Eng review by Daniel Ortega with any follow-up tasks listed in comments
